params.q: What is the UPI transaction limit per day?

search_parameters.q: What is the UPI transaction limit per day?

response.header: The standard UPI daily limit for person‑to‑person transfers is ₹1 lakh, though banks may set lower caps and certain merchant categories allow much higher limits.

text_blocks.snippet: Short answer: Most users can send up to ₹1,00,000 per day via UPI for regular P2P transfers +2 . Banks typically also cap usage at around 20 transactions per day +2 .

list.snippet: Daily P2P limit: ₹1 lakh for most users 3 .
Per‑transaction limit: Usually up to ₹1 lakh for standard transfers 2 .
Transaction count: Most banks/apps allow ~20 transactions per day 3 .

text_blocks.snippet: Banks may apply lower limits for:

list.snippet: Newly added bank accounts (e.g., ₹5,000 for first 24–72 hours) 1 .
Certain public‑sector banks with stricter caps (e.g., PNB ₹25,000) 1 .

text_blocks.snippet: NPCI allows higher limits for specific merchant categories:

list.snippet: Up to ₹5 lakh per transaction for payments like insurance, capital markets, tax payments, and GeM purchases 2 .
Up to ₹10 lakh per day for approved high‑value merchant categories 2 .
The merchant is registered under an approved category.
The bank and UPI app support the higher limit.

text_blocks.snippet: UPI Lite is meant for quick, PIN‑less small payments.
Why Your Actual Limit May Differ

references.title: Maximum Limit of UPI: Per Day Transfer, Merchant & Bank Limits
references.snippet: What Is the Maximum UPI transaction Limit per day? The maximum UPI limit for most personal transfers is ₹1 lakh per day between two bank accounts. This standard cap applies to regular person-to-person transactions made through UPI apps like Google Pay, PhonePe, or Paytm.

references.title: UPI Transaction Limit Per Day: Latest UPI Limits in India
references.snippet: The standard UPI transaction limit per day is up to ₹1 lakh for most regular UPI payments. Your bank, UPI app, account type, and merchant category can set a lower or different effective limit.

references.title: UPI Transaction Limit 2026 – Bank & App Wise | BankZop
references.snippet: For most banks the daily UPI limit is ₹1,00,000 with a maximum of 20 transactions per day. Some banks like IndusInd offer ₹2,00,000 daily for eligible customers.

references.title: Check UPI Daily Limits & Transaction Guidelines | HDFC Bank
references.snippet: The maximum daily transaction limit for UPI is ₹1 lakh, though it can differ depending on your bank. However, for UPI transactions involving foreign inward remittances, capital markets, insurance, and collections, you can transact ₹2 lakh.

references.title: Understanding UPI Transaction Limits: Daily & Monthly Caps
references.snippet: What is the maximum UPI transaction limit per day? The maximum UPI transaction limit per day is generally set at Rs.1 Lakh by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI).

references.title: UPI Transaction Limit Per Day in 2026: Bank-Wise UPI Daily Limit
references.snippet: For most regular UPI transactions, the standard limit is up to ₹1 lakh per transaction. However, your actual daily or monthly transaction capacity may be lower depending on your bank, account, transaction type, and applicable bank-level restrictions.

references.title: UPI Limit Per Day in India: How Much Can You Send?
references.snippet: For normal UPI payments, you can send ₹1 lakh per day. That is the standard NPCI cap and it covers almost everything you do — paying friends, shops, rent, bills.
